title: A Unified Framework to Quantify Cultural Intelligence of AI

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating 'Global Diversity' in model outputs to detect Western-centric defaults in unspecified queries (e.g., popular musicians) and assessing 'Cultural Scoping' to ensure models do not assume a dominant cultural context for ambiguous inputs.

Using a 'Stereotype Avoidance' indicator to evaluate if model-generated descriptions of cultures or regions (e.g., Mexico City) rely on reductive tropes (e.g., 'dangerous', 'lazy') versus complex, authentic representations.

Probing 'Norm Adherence' and 'Pragmatic Proficiency' by asking models to judge social interactions (e.g., dining etiquette, business communication) to ensure they apply local norms rather than imposing a dominant culture's etiquette.

Testing 'Epistemic Fidelity' by querying specific religious rituals (e.g., Christian weddings in Kerala) to ensure the model retrieves accurate localized practices rather than generalizing to Western or dominant religious definitions.
